study_identification_part.si4_title: Multimodal normative modeling in Alzheimer's Disease with introspective variational autoencoders

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Develop and evaluate a multimodal soft-introspective VAE (mmSIVAE) with Mixture-of-Product-of-Experts aggregation to improve normative modeling by better reconstructing healthy controls and detecting individual-level deviations in Alzheimer's disease using ADNI MRI and amyloid PET.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Pearson correlations between D_ml and neuropsychological composite scores (memory, executive, language; Steiger's Z-test to compare methods); supplementary tables also report linear regressions adjusted for age and sex relating deviation indices (DSI) to composites.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: mmSIVAE with MOPOE improved reconstruction of healthy controls and achieved stronger outlier detection (higher likelihood ratios) and clearer HC–ADS separation than baseline VAEs.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Across ROIs, mmSIVAE showed the lowest reconstruction error for MRI volumes and amyloid SUVR relative to SIVAE, mmVAE, and vanilla VAE. For OOD detection with latent deviations, mmSIVAE with MOPOE achieved higher positive likelihood ratios than baselines (e.g., LR = 10.2 at latent dimension d = 15), with consistent gains across d = 5–20. D_ml correlated with cognitive composites (memory, executive, language), and method comparisons used Steiger's Z-test.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Evaluation limited to ADNI; no explicit site/scanner harmonization reported.
caa10_key_limitations.supporting_text: "Through analysis on the ADNI dataset, mmSIVAE demonstrated..."

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: MOPOE aggregation combines PoE and MoE; mapping latent Z-score deviations to feature-space abnormalities for interpretability; ROI z-normalization to HC.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: A separate supplementary set describes Knight ADRC modalities and QC; however, main experiments and normative training/testing reported here use ADNI only.
